title: Existence of a lift of a completed morphism between torsion-controlled arrows
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-torsion-controlled-completion-hom-lift, there exists a coherent-module morphism g:F→F′ with g≫a′=a and completion.map g=θ.

proof.text: Artin--Rees separation for ker(a′) supplies a positive quotient depth n+1 with monomorphic kernel-to-quotient map. Construct g from the finite graph retaining θ, and use the joint construction theorem for both equations. No arbitrary raw lift is selected.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_completion_hom_lift_exists
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H F F' : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (a' : F' ⟶ H)
    (ha : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a.hom))))
    (ha' : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a'.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a'.hom))))
    (θ : (completion X J).obj F ⟶ (completion X J).obj F')
    (hθ : θ ≫ (completion X J).map a' = (completion X J).map a) :
    ∃ g : F ⟶ F', g ≫ a' = a ∧ (completion X J).map g = θ
